subject: Urgent: Verify your account immediately
body:
Dear Customer,

We have detected unusual activity on your account. Your account has been temporarily suspended.

Click here to verify your identity: http://paypa1-secure.com/verify

You must act now - your account will be permanently locked in 24 hours.

Best regards,
PayPal Security Team

subject: Your package delivery update
body:
Hi,

Your package #12345678 is out for delivery today.

Track your shipment: https://www.fedex.com/track

If you have questions, visit our Help Center at fedex.com/help.

Thank you for choosing FedEx.

subject: Congratulations! You have won $1,000,000
body:
Dear User,

Congratulations! You have been selected as a winner in our international lottery.

To claim your prize of $1,000,000, you must respond within 48 hours and provide your bank details for wire transfer.

Click here to claim now: http://lottery-international.tk/claim

Limited time offer. Act now!

Lottery International

subject: Meeting reminder: Project review tomorrow at 10am
body:
Hi team,

This is a reminder that we have the project review meeting tomorrow (Tuesday) at 10:00 AM in Conference Room B.

Please bring your updated slides. Let me know if you cannot make it.

Thanks,
Sarah

subject: Security Alert: Unusual sign-in activity
body:
Dear Account Holder,

We noticed a sign-in from a new device. If this was you, no action is needed.

If not, verify your identity immediately: https://accounts-google.verify-now.ga/secure

Your account may be suspended if you do not verify within 24 hours.

Google Account Team

subject: Your monthly statement is ready
body:
Hello,

Your monthly account statement for January is now available.

Log in to Online Banking at https://www.bank.com (always check the URL) to view your statement.

We never ask for your password via email. If you have questions, call the number on the back of your card.

Bank Customer Service

subject: Your Apple ID has been locked
body:
Dear Customer,

Your Apple ID has been locked due to suspicious activity. You must verify your account within 24 hours or it will be permanently disabled.

Verify now: http://apple-id-secure.tk/restore

Do not reply to this email. Apple will never ask for your password by email.

Apple Support

subject: HR: Benefits enrollment deadline Friday
body:
Hi everyone,

Reminder: Open enrollment for health benefits ends this Friday at 5 PM.

Log in to the employee portal at https://hr.yourcompany.com (use your normal work login) to make your selections.

Questions? Reply to this email or stop by HR.

HR Team

subject: You have a pending refund - confirm your details
body:
Hello,

We are processing a refund of $89.99 to your account. To complete the refund we need you to confirm your payment method.

Click here to confirm: https://amaz0n-support.ga/refund-confirm

This link expires in 12 hours. Do not share it with anyone.

Amazon Customer Service

subject: Invoice #4521 from Acme Corp
body:
Hi,

Please find attached invoice #4521 for services rendered in January.

Payment is due within 30 days. You can pay online at https://acmecorp.com/pay or by check to the address on the invoice.

If you have any questions, reply to this email.

Billing Department
Acme Corp

subject: IMPORTANT: Your Netflix account will be closed
body:
Dear Member,

We were unable to process your payment. Your Netflix account will be closed in 48 hours unless you update your billing information.

Update now: http://netflx-billing.tk/update

We will never ask for your password in an email. If you did not request this, ignore this message.

Netflix Billing

subject: Password reset request
body:
Hi,

You requested a password reset for your company account. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

To reset your password, use this link (expires in 1 hour): https://company.com/reset-password?token=xxxx

Always type company.com yourself or use the link from our official app. We never send password links from other domains.

IT Security
